thread:
Sam W.: Heads-up — US banks holiday next Mon. Thinking we should either shift the biweekly train by 1 day or skip next slot. Any blockers?
Maria G.: I'm +1 to skipping, infra on-call is light that week.
Devon K.: Skipping is fine for our branch, but we have an API version bump queued that needs changelog entry. Can we fast-track the changelog today?
Leah (release-manager): @Devon K. which PR?
Devon K.: PR #4921 — small semver patch (v1.12.3 -> v1.12.4). Changelog: "fix: race in cache invalidation". I can add the notes now.
Toni: If we skip, do we preserve the train numbering? I prefer to keep the cadence and just mark the week as "no release" to avoid downstream confusion. :calendar:
Leah (release-manager): I agree with Toni. Let's mark it as an off-week on the calendar and roll the scheduled releases forward one slot so train IDs align. I'll post an update to the calendar and the release board.
Sam W.: OK — decision: skip next train (1769850000-week). Action items: Devon add changelog today; Leah update calendar & release board; Maria and infra confirm no infra jobs scheduled.
Maria G.: infra checked — no scheduled capacity changes.
Devon K.: Added changelog entry and bumped PR title to include changelog. CC @Leah (release-manager).
Leah (release-manager): Got it. Also updating the branch-freeze_note: "No freeze this week; next freeze is the following Tue." Will ping owners.
release-bot: :robot_face: Calendar entry updated by Leah — "Release train skipped: 1769851234 (holiday week)" — https://calendar.internal/redwood/releases
Sam W.: Quick check — does this affect the canary rollout window for Dedicated customers?
Maria G.: Canary window shifts by 2 days because we're preserving the rollout offset. I'll update the canary schedule in the ops doc.
Toni: Noted. Can someone add a short blurb to the changelog template reminding folks to include owner + impact for skipped weeks? Small ops improvement.
Devon K.: Done (changelog template updated).
Leah (release-manager): Thanks all. I'll send a brief announcement in #general this afternoon and ping the product PMs. If anyone needs a hotfix to go out next week, please escalate to me directly. :thumbsup:
Sam W.: Thanks — closing the loop. :)
